subject: Security qualification follow-up — SOC 2 Type II request & DDQ kickoff for Careverity
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@careverity.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security qualification follow-up — SOC 2 Type II request & DDQ kickoff for Careverity

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the time and for walking through Careverity's integration plan. Per our call, next steps on the compliance side so your security team can complete the vendor assessment: 

1) We can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and an interim bridge letter (temporary attestation) if you need something faster than delivery of the full report.
2) We typically share evidence and artifacts via our Trust Portal; if you can send a portal invite email address I’ll get our Security team to provision access.
3) Please find attached the vendor DDQ we requested you to start — if you prefer, we can fill the preliminary sections and send back for your review.

Proposed timeline: SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — 5 business days to confirm availability and share redacted copy; bridge letter — 1 business day once approved internally; Trust Portal access — within 24–48 hours of an invite.

Action items for today:
- Samir: confirm the security contact to invite to Trust Portal (email and preferred access level).
- Olivia: if you can return the DDQ, we’ll batch any follow-up questions into one doc.

Attachments: [Careverity_Vendor_DDQ_2026-04-07.pdf] (please complete the checklist on page 2)

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben on the bridge letter and Markus on escalation/contract items.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
--
[Attachment: Careverity_Vendor_DDQ_2026-04-07.pdf]

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the recap. I’m the security lead on this engagement — pleased to meet you.

Quick answers:
- Please invite security@careverity.com to the Trust Portal with read-only access to reports and attachments.
- We’ve attached our standard Vendor Security Questionnaire (DDQ). Could you confirm whether you prefer us to upload the completed DDQ to the Trust Portal or return via email?
- For timelines: if you can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter by next Thursday (2026-04-15), that would keep our procurement timeline on track.

Also: we have a couple of clarifying questions in the DDQ about data residency and encryption-at-rest for customer data — I left those as numbered items.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Senior Security Analyst — Careverity
olivia.turner@careverity.com

Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security qualification follow-up — SOC 2 Type II request & DDQ kickoff for Careverity

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for confirming — we’ll proceed as follows:

1) Trust Portal invite: I’ve requested an invite to security@careverity.com with read-only access to reports and attachments. You should receive an automated invite from trust@redwood.com in the next 24 hours. If you do not see it, check spam and let me know and I’ll escalate.

2) DDQ: please upload the completed DDQ to the Trust Portal once you receive access; if you prefer to return via email, that’s fine too. We’ll redact and upload our SOC artifacts there for your team review.

3) SOC 2 & bridge letter: Ben — can you confirm if we have a redacted SOC 2 Type II copy available to share and prepare a bridge letter? Markus — looping you for contract/terms impacts if Careverity needs additional redaction.

Target dates: redacted SOC 2 & bridge letter delivered by 2026-04-15 (target), Trust Portal invite within 24 hours. We’ll flag any blockers early.

Olivia — couple of quick clarifications from your DDQ: encryption-at-rest question — we store customer keys in a KMS and can provide architecture notes; data residency — our hosted API region options include US and EU; we’ll call out specifics once you upload the DDQ entries that reference production scenarios.

Best,
Logan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
